title: Auto-Rubric奖励：从隐式偏好到显式多模态生成标准
summary: 提出Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR)框架，将隐式偏好知识显式化为可解释的多维标准，用于多模态生成模型对齐。结合Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO)将结构化评估蒸馏为稳健的二元奖励，在文本到图像生成和图像编辑任务上优于成对奖励模型和VLM评判器，实现了更可靠、数据高效的对齐。
summary_en: Proposes Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR), a framework that externalizes implicit preference knowledge into interpretable, multi-dimensional rubrics for multimodal generative model alignment. Combined with Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO), it distills structured evaluation into robust binary rewards, outperforming pairwise reward models and VLM judges on text-to-image generation and image editing benchmarks, achieving more reliable and data-efficient alignment.
